text: Writing the Saltmarsh renewal brief. What discount are we on with Saltmarsh Provisions? I thought Bettina said 12 at some point.
reply_text:
Kwame, you did see Bettina say 12, but she retracted it. On 2025-11-17 in this channel she posted that the Saltmarsh Provisions discount was 12%. Five minutes later she corrected it to 10%, saying she had misread a draft worksheet from June Osei-Lark.

That 10% is the last figure stated in this channel, and it's almost a year old. I can't see any Saltmarsh contract or CRM files, so I haven't checked it against the signed terms or any change since. For the renewal brief, please confirm it with June Osei-Lark, or with the account owner if that's not you.

text: Separate ask from me: who is our main contact at Saltmarsh and what is her title? Moss's Coastal cheat sheet should have it.
